test_title: PYST 46: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 31 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

New Delhi: India :: Kyiv : ?
solution:
**Logic :** Capital : Country

So,

__
 
• **New Delhi** is the capital of **India**.

Similarly,

 
• **Kyiv** is the capital of **Ukraine**.

Hence, "Ukraine" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Russia → Capital is Moscow.
 
• Mongolia → Capital is Ulaanbaatar
 
• Moldova → Capital is Chisinau
 
• Ukraine → Capital is Kyiv
